snippets.title: Multi-author commit script
snippets.code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# multi-author-commit.sh — commit staged changes with a random author identity

set -euo pipefail

# Add as many contributors as you want (name|email)
AUTHORS=(
  "Alice|alice@users.noreply.github.com"
  "Bob|bob@users.noreply.github.com"
  "Carol|carol@users.noreply.github.com"
  "Dave|dave@users.noreply.github.com"
  "Eve|eve@users.noreply.github.com"
)

COMMIT_MSG="${1:-Update content}"

# Pick random author
idx=$((RANDOM % ${#AUTHORS[@]}))
entry="${AUTHORS[$idx]}"
name="${entry%%|*}"
email="${entry##*|}"

if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
  git commit --author="${name} <${email}>" -m "${COMMIT_MSG}"
  echo "Committed as: ${name} <${email}>"
else
  echo "Nothing staged. Run: git add <files>"
  exit 1
fi
snippets.desc: Bash script: picks a random author from AUTHORS and commits staged changes. Save as commit.sh and run after git add.
